rust_summary: opt-in client item-slot cooldown drawing between the bar and shade/count stages in `native_item_slot.rs`.
doc_summary: client slot cooldown drawing: set `listened` in `item_slot_cooldown_listened(listened)` to opt in before the first slot draw. `item_slot_cooldown(batch, stack, rect, cooldown, partial_tick) -> Flow` runs after the item bar and before the cooldown shade/count. `rect` is `[left, top, width, height]` in GUI coordinates; `cooldown` is `Some((fraction, remaining_ticks))` for an active local cooldown and `None` otherwise. Returning `Cancel` stops later cooldown listeners and suppresses only the white shade, preserving bar, count/custom count, item foil and the existing post-decoration hook. Interest is collected once after native mods load. With no interest, the original combined decoration path runs without another cooldown lookup or draw allocation. Bundles need the @API:item_slot_cooldown@ hook requirement.
